name: discord-mcp
description: Discord MCP server with FTS5 search, HITL approvals, and multi-persona webhooks.
long_description: A static, CGO-free Go MCP server for Discord: 44 tools, discord:// resources with live subscriptions, prompts, an embedded SQLite FTS5 search index, human-in-the-loop buttons/selects/modals, multi-persona webhooks, and a governance policy engine with read-only mode and dry-run previews.

discord_bot_token.title: Discord Bot Token
discord_bot_token.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

default_guild_id.title: Default Server ID
default_guild_id.description: Optional guild Snowflake used when a tool omits guild_id.

db_path.title: Search Index Path
db_path.description: :memory: (RAM only) or a file path for a persistent index.

read_only_mode.title: Read-only Mode
read_only_mode.description: Block all write and destructive tools.

tools.name: discord_login
tools.description: Authenticate or switch the active bot profile.

tools.name: discord_list_servers
tools.description: List the guilds the bot belongs to with member counts and owners.

tools.name: discord_get_server_info
tools.description: Get guild metadata, channels, roles, boost tier, and features.

tools.name: discord_send
tools.description: Send text, an embed, or up to 10 local files to a channel or thread as the bot.

tools.name: discord_read_messages
tools.description: Read message history with resolved mentions.

tools.name: discord_edit_message
tools.description: Edit a bot-authored message.

tools.name: discord_delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_bulk_delete_messages
tools.description: Bulk delete 2-100 messages younger than 14 days (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message.

tools.name: discord_add_multiple_reactions
tools.description: Add an ordered list of emoji reactions to a message.

tools.name: discord_remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a message.

tools.name: discord_create_text_channel
tools.description: Create a text or announcement channel.

tools.name: discord_create_voice_channel
tools.description: Create a voice or stage channel.

tools.name: discord_create_category
tools.description: Create a channel category.

tools.name: discord_edit_channel
tools.description: Edit a channel's name, topic, category, or archive state (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_delete_channel
tools.description: Delete a channel (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_set_channel_permissions
tools.description: Set or remove role/member permission overwrites on a channel (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_create_forum_channel
tools.description: Create a forum channel with tags and a default reaction.

tools.name: discord_create_forum_post
tools.description: Start a forum post with an initial message and tags.

tools.name: discord_get_forum_post
tools.description: Fetch a forum post's starter message and replies.

tools.name: discord_reply_to_forum
tools.description: Reply inside a forum post.

tools.name: discord_list_forum_threads
tools.description: List active and optionally archived posts in a forum.

tools.name: discord_list_members
tools.description: List guild members with roles and join dates.

tools.name: discord_manage_roles
tools.description: List, create, edit, delete, assign, or revoke roles (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a channel webhook (token never returned).

tools.name: discord_send_webhook_message
tools.description: Send a message, embed, or files through a webhook.

tools.name: discord_edit_webhook
tools.description: Rename or move a webhook (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_search_messages
tools.description: Full-text FTS5 search over indexed messages with automatic REST backfill.

tools.name: discord_await_interaction
tools.description: Post buttons, a select menu, or a modal and wait for an authorised human response.

tools.name: discord_persona_register
tools.description: Register or update a reusable webhook persona.

tools.name: discord_persona_send
tools.description: Send text, an embed, or files as a registered persona via an auto-managed webhook.

tools.name: discord_create_poll
tools.description: Create a native Discord poll.

tools.name: discord_get_poll_results
tools.description: Get poll vote tallies and winners.

tools.name: discord_manage_threads
tools.description: Create, archive, unarchive, lock, or unlock threads (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_manage_events
tools.description: List or create guild scheduled events.

tools.name: discord_governance_audit
tools.description: Query audit logs, list AutoMod rules, or time out a member (supports dry_run).

tools.name: discord_get_member_avatar
tools.description: Get a member's avatar URLs and display name.

tools.name: discord_fetch_media
tools.description: Download an attachment, author avatar, or any public URL; return it inline as base64 or save it to the local media folder.

tools.name: fetch_url_to_file
tools.description: Save an image from any public URL to the local media folder.

tools.name: discord_batch_fetch_media
tools.description: Save up to 25 Discord attachments/avatars to the local media folder in one call.

tools.name: media_list_files
tools.description: List the files in the local media folder.

tools.name: discord_list_tuppers
tools.description: List webhook identities (Tupperbox/PluralKit characters) with their latest avatar URLs.

tools.name: discord_check_access
tools.description: Diagnose which channels the bot can view and read, with a fix for each blocked one.
